name: VRHush
summary: Boutique VR studio focused on slow-burn sensual pacing, intimate lighting, and clean 6K–8K framing rather than frantic assembly-line shoots.
ranking_rationale: Carves out a clear boutique lane in adult VR with intimate lighting, realistic scale, and unhurried performer chemistry—smaller catalog, high craft.

pricing.notes: Varies by plan and promo; check official checkout.

pros: Intimate, sensual pacing that feels less rushed than volume VR studios
Clean 6K–8K visual quality with accurate scale calibration
Strong casting of both mainstream stars and boutique performers
cons: Smaller total scene count than megastudio VR networks
Narrower genre variety if you want hardcore or cosplay

facts.value: Paid VR membership with streaming and direct downloads
Slow-burn sensual direction and intimate VR framing
